scoring_justification: The checker directly compares the agent-computed optimal angles to the paper-reported values within a tolerance, and verifies seasonal trends. Recomputing the full optimization in the checker is unnecessary; this deterministic geometric optimization has known optimal angles, and tolerance (±1.5°) absorbs solver/numerical differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold optimal reflector angles for summer and winter solstices as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'maximum calculated value of the optimal angle of the bottom reflector is 65.72° ... minimum ... 33.32° ... top reflector ... maximum ... 7.98° ... minimum ... -24.41°.' Fig. 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's explicit numerical statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported optimal angles; not invented.

outputs.description: Computed optimal tilt angles for the bottom (α₁) and top (α₂) reflectors at the summer and winter solstices.

output_contract.notes: The verifier compares the computed angles to the paper-reported values with a tolerance and checks the seasonal trend (alpha1 larger in summer, alpha2 smaller in summer).
